title: Formless spiritual. Father, Word and Holy Breath. Allfather, the heavenly man. Hiesos Kristos, magician of the beautiful, the Logos who suffers in us at every moment. This verily is that. I am the fire upon the altar. I am the sacrificial butter.
html_source:
Joyce places AE’s mysticism in early Christian terms and derides him.

Butter : AE aswell as a mystic, theosophist, poet and critic was involved in Irish agrarian affairs via the Irish Agricultural Organisation Society.

The passsage “I am the fire upon the altar. I am the sacrificial butter.” is also a play on the Bhagavad-gita:

“But it is I who am the ritual, I the sacrifice, the offering to the ancestors, the healing herb, the transcendental chant. I am the butter and the fire and the offering.”
((9.16)
